data_fields.name: lead_in_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: negative start time (value from chart, not in donor)

best_idea: Layered music is stems on one clock, each with its own latency offset; a whiff ducks only the player's vocal stem unless an animation has claimed it, and the voice pool refuses new quiet sounds at the cap rather than stealing.
decision_why: The one-clock stem group and the whiff duck fit a fight whose presentation must answer the player's input; the server still decides the hit, so the duck is a presentation cue only. Drop the openfl cap for a Frankendom voice budget and fix the lead-in overshoot and the completion relay.
acceptance: When the player's attack whiffs, the player's vocal stem falls to zero in the same frame while the instrumental keeps playing; a headless test seeds one whiff and asserts player-vocal gain 0 and instrumental gain 1 at the same clock time, and a test with the temp-vocal flag set leaves the stem audible.
